q: when do the harbor pumps run

results.title: Harbor Pumps
results.snippet: The harbor pumps drain the lower dock every night at 02:00. If the float switch sticks, reset it by hand and log the event in the tide book. Pumps run on the backup generator during storms.

results.title: Fog Signals
results.snippet: The fog horn sounds every ninety seconds when visibility drops below a quarter mile. Test the horn weekly and keep the compressor drained. A silent horn must be reported to the harbor master at once.

results.title: Crew Canteen
results.snippet: The canteen serves fish stew on Fridays and bread every morning. Report allergies to the cook. Leftovers are discarded after two days.
